notes.title: V0.2.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
New Content

 added stunned keyword
 added activated abilities to some units (Sniper,Fletcher,Drummer,Recruitment Tent,Champion,Armorer,Squad Leader,Scout,Archer,Sergeant)
 added the ability to rearrange talents to charge trigger order
 added new trinket that protects against the first stun each turn


Balance Changes

 changed dark cave event so rarer units are more likely to survive
 Recruitment tent cost 2 -> 3
 Changed shop prices


Quality of life changes

 Added highlight to show which cards card be played
 Added visual indicator if you try to play a can you can't afford
 Added highlight to end turn button when no more actions can be taken
 Added option to automatically end turn when no more actions can be taken
 Increased move animation speed
 When starting new runs the previous difficulty settings will be the default instead of reverting to easy
 Made foresight the default in fight deck view if available
 Made conditional talents pulse when condition is met (eg: Patient when you passed the last turn without playing a card)
 Added windowed fullscreen option
 Talent bar can now handle having too many talents
 Added confirmation to return to menu and quit buttons


Bug fixes

 Fixed bug where the changing light event could turn cards into thing other than units
 Removed n from keyword explainer text that shouldn't have it
 Fixed an issue that could prevent game from launching
 Fixed shops regenerating if reopened
 Fixed a soft lock that could occure if the turn is ended while dragging a card
 Fixed let chaos reign not working as intended
 Fixed a problem with the chaotic mind talent that caused a soft lock


other

 Added animation when buying things at a shop
